annotatedSteps.correctedWorking: Draw a right-angled triangle ABC with right angle at B, vertical tower AB = h, shadow BC = 20 m, and angle of elevation ∠ACB = 60°.

annotatedSteps.description: Setting up the trigonometric ratio tan 60° = h / 20
Substituting value of tan 60° and solving for height h

teacherNote: You correctly chose the tangent ratio for this problem. However, always draw a neat labelled figure for Heights and Distances questions, and remember that tan 60° = √3 (not 1/√3).
